## Sucrose Preference Test

-- **Illustration:**  
Boxplots and individual scores  

```{r data_loading}

rm(list = ls())
dir = getwd()

#--------------------------- 1. Manual Entries -----------------------------#
# 1.1 INPUT FILES 
file_path <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/Sucrose/"

raw_data_file <- "sucrose_preference_test_new.xlsx"

# 1.2 PLOT
#here we define the colors we going to use for the different strains in the plots
color_flu <- c('#0099CC', '#FF9900', '#DC143C', '#8B008B')


#---------------------------2. LOAD DATA-----------------------------#
# Load data
raw_data = read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file, sep=""))  # read excel file

#get list of strains without NAs
list_of_genotypes <- sort(na.omit(unique(raw_data$genotype)), decreasing = T)

data_suc <- raw_data %>%
  # Factor the genotype/group variable
  mutate(Genotype = factor(genotype, levels = list_of_genotypes),
         # creates new col with Cohort as.factors
         Cohort = as.factor(cohort),  # otherwise ggplot raises an error
         # calculate water intake and save it in a new column
         water_in = (`water_b(g)` - `water_a(g)`),
         # calculate sucrose intake and save it in a new column
         sucrose_in = (`sucrose_b(g)` - `sucrose_a(g)`),
         # calculate sucrose preference and save it in a new column
         sucrose_pref = sucrose_in/(sucrose_in + water_in)) 

```

### Results

#### Test phase

##### Sucrose preference 

```{r pl_suc_pref, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}

#---------------------------3. ANALYSIS-----------------------------#
# 3.1 Sucrose preference of animals during test phase 

pl_suc_pref <- data_suc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Genotype, y = sucrose_pref, color = Genotype, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add color by strain
  scale_colour_manual(values = color_flu) +
  #add points shaped by cohort and not overlapping positions
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.05), aes(shape = Cohort), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5) +
  #remove filling (length of values needs to be equal to number of cohorts)
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,2)) +
  #ids as label
  geom_text(hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.05) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Sucrose preference score",  
       title = "Sucrose Preference") +
  #y-limit
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() + 
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

pl_suc_pref

```

__Figure 1.__ Comparison of sucrose preference between genotypes.

__Statistics for Figure 1. Sucrose preference stats__

```{r pl_suc_pref stats}

#for the kruskal wallis we need to have the genotype/Group = as.factor(genotype)
kruskal.test(sucrose_pref~Genotype, data = data_suc)

```
